findings.title: Retrieval-nudge branch drops the submit tool_result and discards a completed submission
findings.evidence: unit-1.01.json compile.unresolvedIssues[0]: HTTP 400 'tool_use ids were found without tool_result blocks immediately after' on messages.2 after a 312k-input/60k-output first turn; lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/caller.ts pushes the assistant message containing the submit_compilation tool_use and then a plain-text user nudge with no tool_result when sufficiency is UNSUPPORTED/MISSING_CONTEXT and no tools were called
findings.effect: Whole 353k-char definitions unit lost ($2.04 spent, 0 rules); classified PROVIDER_FAILURE although it is a caller protocol defect

findings.title: Section 6.08 sub-clause labels mis-nested: the Available Amount builder's lettered sub-clauses (a)-(h) inside 6.08(a)(3) are promoted to SUBSECTION level, so the real 6.08(b) is labelled 6.08(i) and 6.08(b)(N) becomes 6.08(i)(ii)(N)
findings.evidence: stage1-all-nodes: 6.08(b) SUBSECTION at char 665769 (inside the builder) vs the real 'Section 6.08(a) shall not prohibit' at 670071; deterministic candidates and 3E units carry refs like 6.08(i)(ii)(9)
findings.effect: Compiler-emitted sourceSectionRef '6.08(b)(12)' cannot be anchored to 3E units or 2B candidates; the 3E audit reports the compiled 6.08 as UNREPRESENTED/AMBIGUOUS_MATCH (safe direction, but coverage evidence for the one compiled covenant section is lost); 2B normalizedSourceRefs for 6.08 are wrong

findings.title: Million-scale amounts parsed without scale: '$720.0 million' -> 720 vs IR 720000000
findings.evidence: unit-6.08 verify.sourceInventory AMOUNT '$540.0 million' -> 540; 22 of 25 MATERIAL findings on 6.08 are MISSING_BASKET/UNSUPPORTED_IR_ADDITION pairs on million-scale figures; lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic-verification/source-inventory.ts parseMoney ignores 'million'; the same pattern is visible in the earlier holdout run (18-verifier-analysis: '$37.5 million' findings attributed to composition omission)
findings.effect: Verifier status MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY driven largely by parser artefacts; genuine omissions ($540M/$252M/$504M, 50%/140%/75%/35%/70%/6%/7%, 2.00x/1.75x) are also reported, so the direction is safe but precision is poor; 42 million-form amounts in this agreement vs 0 in the DSGR/Riot/LSB fixtures

findings.title: Verifier flags a tool-retrieved definition as fabricated
findings.evidence: 6.08 finding on definitions[2] Threshold Amount: 'no source text or retrieved context anywhere states...'; the compile toolCallLog shows getDefinition('Threshold Amount') was called and the source definition (offset 350042) is exactly greater of $324.0M and 45% of Consolidated EBITDA
findings.effect: Verifier does not see compiler tool retrievals, so correct retrieved values are reported as unsupported additions

findings.title: Pass A run-to-run instability on a real 38k-char unit
findings.evidence: 6.08: run 1 288 items / run 2 307 items; strict 0.19, semantic 0.45, critical/material 0.46; 99 material items only in run 1, 121 only in run 2; both runs INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP
findings.effect: Inventory content is not reproducible at the item level; accountability is established against whichever run the compile consumed

findings.title: Quantitative sub-expressions fail IR type-check and degrade to UNSUPPORTED
findings.evidence: 6.08 rules (b)(4) ADD, (b)(9) SUBTRACT, (b)(10)/(b)(25) AND gates, definitions Available Amount / Available RP Capacity Amount / Available Investment Capacity Amount SUBTRACT all UNSUPPORTED ('operands do not type-check'); 20 UNSUPPORTED dispositions, 13 MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION (10 critical)
findings.effect: Ratio RP basket, IPO dividend basket, Available Amount builder and shared-capacity definitions are not computable; compile PARTIAL with IR_VALIDATION_FAILURE
